facts.detail: The BDUK Research Portal was first published in October 2020 and last updated on 26 June 2026.
The portal groups evaluations, in-house research, evaluation plans and commissioned research.
BDUK describes a multidisciplinary team of data analysts, modellers, social researchers, economists and designers.
The portal's stated purpose is to assess intervention efficacy, inform programme design and understand impacts.
The update history records addition of the BDUK GigaHubs Evaluation on 26 June 2026.

facts.detail: The process review was conducted by Belmana working with GC Insight.
The Hub product supports gigabit-capable connections for remote public buildings such as schools, GP surgeries and libraries.
The wider multi-stage evaluation runs from 2022 to 2027.
The process review covers the GigaHubs programme that delivered the Hub product during 2021 to 2026.
Evidence includes BDUK management data and interviews with government, local authorities, suppliers and site representatives.

facts.detail: BDUK published its performance-information collection on 24 July 2025.
The collection centralises links to BDUK performance reporting.
It groups delivery statistics, Project Gigabit contract reports and BDUK annual reports and accounts.
BDUK states that it began reporting delivery performance as official statistics in 2025.
The collection directs users to OMR determinations and premises in BDUK plans for related premises-level information.

facts.detail: Ofcom's infrastructure-reports collection was published in December 2023 and last updated on 27 May 2026.
The collection focuses on coverage and performance of fixed broadband and mobile networks.
Ofcom publishes an annual Connected Nations report on UK communications infrastructure.
Ofcom also publishes a mid-year coverage update and a planned-network-deployment update.
The 2026 entries include a January 2026 coverage snapshot and forward-looking deployment plans through the end of 2028.
